paraphrase: No-thought is the tenet, non-action the root; true emptiness is the substance, wondrous existence the function; true suchness is without thought and is not known by thinking; so samādhi is no-samādhi, wisdom no-wisdom, practice no-practice; the nature is equal to space and the substance the same as the dharma-realm.

original.text: 無念為宗無作為本。真空為體妙有為用
